intro: A researcher in a stained lab coat waves you over, surrounded by centrifuges that are definitely not licensed.
speaker: Gene Doctor
introDialogue: Every Pokémon carries a sleeping self — the ability written in its genes but never expressed.$For a fee, I can wake it. Precisely. Permanently.$...Or, if you're short on funds, there's always the roulette. The genes decide. The genes are not always kind.
title: Recessive Genes
description: The doctor offers two services: pay gold to awaken one Pokémon's HIDDEN ABILITY (guaranteed, permanent), or spin the free Gene Roulette — its ability is re-rolled at random among everything its species can carry.
invalidSelection: Its hidden self is already awake — or it has none.

1.label: The Awakening
1.tooltip:
(-) Costs gold
(+) One Pokémon's ability becomes its HIDDEN ability, permanently
1.selected: Hold it steady. The sleeping self wakes... now.

2.label: Gene Roulette
2.tooltip:
(+) Free: ability re-rolled among ALL its species' abilities
(-) The genes decide. The genes are not always kind.
2.selected: Round and round the double helix goes! Where it stops — well. Let's find out together.

3.label: Decline Treatment
3.selected: Wise, perhaps. The genes keep their secrets a little longer.

outro: The doctor is already elbow-deep in the next centrifuge before you've finished walking away.
